source_text: Recapitulatio Libri III historica: a cubili umbroso et oculis columbae per tigna cedrina et florem campi, malum inter ligna, cellam vinariam, sinistram et dexteram, vocem salientem, hiemem transitam, ficum et foramen petrae, usque ad ostensionem faciei et captionem vulpium.
pass_a_gloss: Recapitulation of-Book III historical: from couch shaded and eyes of-dove through beams cedar and flower of-field, apple among woods, cellar of-wine, left and right, voice leaping, winter passed, fig and hollow of-rock, as-far-as to showing of-face and catching of-foxes.
pass_b_english: Historical recapitulation of Book III: from the shaded couch and dove-eyes through cedar beams and the flower of the field, the apple among the trees, the wine cellar, left hand and right, the leaping voice, winter past, the fig and the hollow of the rock, as far as the showing of the face and the catching of the foxes.
